description: Chains of nested convex loops around the collision C_12 for five mass triples without a waist (curve-shortening leaves, saved whenever some point moved a g-distance 0.01 (0.001 at (1,0.2,0.19)), the length dropped by 0.05 or the chart radius shrank by 3 %), as points z of the chart z = (w2, w3) / (1 - w1) of the unit shape sphere (C_12 at z = 0). Checked by verify/verify_converse.py, which reads only the loops.
